We need to determine appropriate criminal charge(s) for the described facts.

Facts: Defendant Xing (邢某) was accountant for a village group, responsible for cash management of land expropriation compensation. In May 2015, the management committee pre-allocated 1,000,160 yuan (100.016? maybe 1,000,160) of compensation. He was entrusted to keep and disburse to farmers. On Sep 2, 2015, he embezzled (misappropriated) 300,000 yuan of the compensation, borrowing with Jiang (someone). On Dec 20, Jiang 2 (maybe same) from the same area misappropriated 300,000 and returned the 300,000 that Xing had misappropriated. So Xing misappropriated 300,000 of public funds (land compensation) that he was entrusted to manage. This is a case of embezzlement of public funds, i.e., "挪用公款" (misappropriation of public funds) or "挪用资金" (embezzlement). The correct label in Chinese criminal law: "挪用公款罪". However the examples show "挪用资金" as a label for similar case (the earlier example: "挪用资金" for a case where a person misappropriated travel agency funds). So we should use "挪用资金". But need to see if there is a specific term: "挪用公款罪" is typical. The example: "挪用资金" used for a case where a person misappropriated travel agency funds (the earlier example: "挪用资金" for a case where a person misused travel agency funds). So we can output "挪用资金". Also could be "挪用公款". The instruction: Use the EXACT official label — do not append or drop characters. The label list from examples: "挪用资金". So we will output that.

Check if any other charge: maybe "受贿"? No, he didn't receive bribes, he misappropriated. So single charge.

Thus final answer: [罪名]挪用资金<eoa>
